To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
astrocytes from dorsal spinal cord express a novel P2‐ purinoceptor, which is activated by UTP and is insensitive to pertussis toxin.
a novel class of P2‐purinoreceptor, the P2‐purine receptor, is expressed in a subpopulation (about 30%) of astrocytes of the dorsal spinal cord.
astrocytes in dorsal spinal cord express a novel class of P2U‐ purinoceptor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the expression of P2‐purinoreceptors by astrocytes from dorsal spinal cord.
the identification of the purinoceptor subtypes present in dorsal spinal cord astrocytes.
the expression and function of purinoceptors in astrocytes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
astrocytes from rat dorsal spinal cord express two types of P2‐purinoreceptors, one of which is a P2Y‐type and the other a P2U‐type, both of which mediate a rise in [Ca 2+ ]i.
dorsal spinal astrocyte populations are heterogeneous in their responses to P2 purinergic receptor activation.
the dorsal spinal cord contains at least three types of P2‐purinoreceptors, P2Y1, P2Y2 and P2U.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the dorsal spinal cord contains three classes of P2‐purinoreceptor: (1) P2Y‐receptors which are expressed by nearly all dorsal spinal astrocyte, (2) P2X‐receptors which mediate fast excitatory neurotransmission and (3) P2U‐receptors, expressed by a sub‐population of astrocyte, which mediate slow excitatory neurotransmission
P2Y‐ and P2U‐receptors are expressed in dorsal spinal astroglial cells, and both receptors can mediate Ca2+ release from intracellular stores.
P2‐purinergic receptors can be subdivided into two major classes: P2Y‐receptors and P2U‐receptors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
astrocyte‐specific purinergic receptors are not all alike, and this is an important point to keep in mind when considering astrocyte‐based therapies.
the P2U class of purinoceptors has not been described in the nervous system before and that this class of purinoceptor is expressed in a subpopulation astrocytes from dorsal spinal cord.
astrocytes from dorsal spinal cord express a novel P2‐receptor, P2U.
